histologic_grade.label: Histologic grade
histologic_grade.note: FIGO grading applies to endometrioid carcinomas only. All other subtypes are considered high-grade.

status.label: Myometrial invasion
options: Present, outer half (greater than or equal to 50%)

other_tissue_organ_involvement.label: Other tissue / organ involvement
options: Not applicable (no other tissues / organs submitted)
Not identified (other tissues / organs submitted and not involved)

lymphovascular_invasion.label: Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion
lymphovascular_invasion.note: Report the maximum number of LVI foci present on the single slide with the highest number of foci.

extent.label: Extent of LVI
options: Less than or equal to 4 foci
Greater than or equal to 5 foci

margin_status.label: Margin status
margin_status.note: Required only if cervix and / or parametrium / paracervix is involved by carcinoma.

distance_from_carcinoma_to_closest_margi.label: Distance from carcinoma to closest margin

regional_lymph_node_status.label: Regional lymph node status
options: Not applicable (no regional lymph nodes submitted or found)
All regional lymph nodes negative for tumor cells
Tumor present in pelvic lymph node(s)
Tumor present in para-aortic lymph node(s)

macrometastasis_total.label: Total number of pelvic nodes with macrometastasis

macrometastasis_sentinel.label: Number of pelvic sentinel nodes with macrometastasis

micrometastasis_total.label: Total number of pelvic nodes with micrometastasis

micrometastasis_sentinel.label: Number of pelvic sentinel nodes with micrometastasis

itc_total.label: Total number of pelvic nodes with isolated tumor cells

itc_sentinel.label: Number of pelvic sentinel nodes with isolated tumor cells

laterality_with_tumor.label: Laterality of pelvic node(s) with tumor

largest_metastatic_deposit_size_mm.label: Size of largest pelvic nodal metastatic deposit

total_examined.label: Total number of pelvic nodes examined

sentinel_examined.label: Number of pelvic sentinel nodes examined

macrometastasis_total.label: Total number of para-aortic nodes with macrometastasis

macrometastasis_sentinel.label: Number of para-aortic sentinel nodes with macrometastasis

micrometastasis_total.label: Total number of para-aortic nodes with micrometastasis

micrometastasis_sentinel.label: Number of para-aortic sentinel nodes with micrometastasis

itc_total.label: Total number of para-aortic nodes with isolated tumor cells

itc_sentinel.label: Number of para-aortic sentinel nodes with isolated tumor cells

laterality_with_tumor.label: Laterality of para-aortic node(s) with tumor

largest_metastatic_deposit_size_mm.label: Size of largest para-aortic nodal metastatic deposit

total_examined.label: Total number of para-aortic nodes examined

sentinel_examined.label: Number of para-aortic sentinel nodes examined

pT_category.label: pT category
options: pT0: No evidence of primary tumor
pT1a: Tumor limited to the endometrium or invading less than one half of the myometrium
pT1b: Tumor invading one half or more of the myometrium
pT1: Tumor confined to the corpus uteri, NOS (subcategory cannot be determined)
pT2: Tumor invades stromal connective tissue of the cervix but does not extend beyond the uterus (does not include endocervical glandular involvement)
pT3a: Tumor involves serosa and/or adnexa (direct extension or metastasis)
pT3b: Vaginal involvement (direct extension or metastasis) or parametrial involvement
pT3: Tumor extends beyond the uterus, NOS (subcategory cannot be determined)
pT4: Tumor invades bladder mucosa and/or bowel mucosa (bullous edema is not sufficient to classify a tumor as pT4)

T_suffix.label: T suffix
options: (m) multiple primary synchronous tumors in a single organ

pN_category.label: pN category
options: pN not assigned (no nodes submitted or found)
pN not assigned (cannot be determined based on available pathological information)
pN0: No regional lymph node metastasis
pN0(i+): Isolated tumor cells in regional lymph node(s) no greater than 0.2 mm
pN1mi: Regional lymph node micrometastasis (greater than 0.2 mm but not greater than 2.0 mm)
pN1a: Regional lymph node macrometastasis to pelvic lymph nodes (greater than 2.0 mm)
pN1: Regional lymph node metastasis to pelvic lymph nodes (subcategory cannot be determined)
pN2mi: Regional lymph node micrometastasis (greater than 0.2 mm but not greater than 2.0 mm) to para-aortic lymph nodes with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
pN2a: Regional lymph node macrometastasis (greater than 2.0 mm) to para-aortic lymph nodes with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
pN2: Regional lymph node metastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes (subcategory cannot be determined)

pM_category.label: pM category
options: Not applicable - pM cannot be determined from the submitted specimen(s)

pM1: Distant metastasis (includes inguinal lymph nodes and intraperitoneal disease or lung, liver, or bone). It excludes metastasis to pelvic or para-aortic lymph nodes, vagina, uterine serosa, or adnexa

figo_2023.label: FIGO Stage (2023 Staging for Cancer of the Endometrium)
options: I: Tumor confined to the corpus uteri and the ovary

IA: Disease limited to the endometrium OR non-aggressive histological type (i.e., low-grade endometrioid) with less than 50% myometrial invasion without LVSI or with focal LVSI OR disease of favorable prognosis
IA1: Non-aggressive histological type limited to an endometrial polyp OR confined to the endometrium
IA2: Non-aggressive histological types with less than 50% myometrial invasion without LVSI or with focal LVSI
IA3: Low-grade endometrioid carcinomas limited to the uterus and the ovary
IAm (POLEmut): Endometrial carcinoma with POLE mutation, confined to the corpus uteri or with cervical extension, regardless of LVSI degree or histological type
IB: Non-aggressive histological types with 50% or more myometrial invasion without LVSI or with focal LVSI
IC: Aggressive histological types confined to a polyp or confined to the endometrium
II: Cervical stromal invasion without extra-uterine extension OR substantial LVSI OR aggressive histological types with myometrial invasion
IIA: Cervical stromal invasion by non-aggressive histological types
IIB: Substantial LVSI in non-aggressive histological types
IIC: Aggressive histological types with any myometrial involvement
IICm (p53abn): Endometrial carcinoma with abnormal p53, confined to corpus uteri with any myometrial invasion, with or without cervical invasion, regardless of LVSI degree or histological type
III: Local and/or regional spread of the tumor of any histological subtype
IIIA: Invasion of uterine serosa, adnexa, or both by direct extension or metastasis
IIIA1: Spread to the ovary or fallopian tube (unless it meets criteria for stage IA3)
IIIA2: Involvement of the sub-serosal compartment of the uterus or spread through the uterine serosa
IIIB: Metastasis or direct spread to the vagina and/or parametria or pelvic peritoneum
IIIB1: Metastasis or direct spread to the vagina and/or parametria
IIIB2: Metastasis to the pelvic peritoneum
IIIC: Metastasis to pelvic or para-aortic lymph nodes or both
IIIC1: Metastasis to pelvic lymph nodes
IIIC2: Metastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes up to renal vessels, with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
IIIC2i: Micrometastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes up to renal vessels, with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
IIIC2ii: Macrometastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes up to renal vessels, with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
IVA: Invasion of bladder mucosa and/or bowel mucosa
IVB: Peritoneal metastasis beyond the pelvis (abdominal peritoneal metastasis)
IVC: Distant metastasis, including metastasis to any extra- or intra-abdominal lymph nodes above renal vessels, lung, liver, brain, or bone
